description: This file defines utility classes for managing promises and scope control, including a custom ManualPromise class and LongStandingScope class, with functions for error cloning and stack trace capture.

classes.name: ManualPromise
classes.description: A custom Promise subclass that allows manual resolution and rejection, with overridden species and string tag.

classes.name: LongStandingScope
classes.description: A class managing long-lived scope with methods to reject, close, and race multiple promises with scope control.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Checks if the ManualPromise has been resolved or rejected.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the ManualPromise with a value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the ManualPromise with an error.

methods.name: raceMultiple
methods.description: Races a promise against multiple LongStandingScope instances.

methods.name: race
methods.description: Races a promise within the scope, considering scope termination.

methods.name: safeRace
methods.description: Performs a race that returns a default value or undefined if scope is terminated.
